name: Geometric Prior Guided Geometry Learning
aliases: Volume Rendering Optimization with Normal Loss
definition: A two-stage learning mechanism. Stage 1 (Pre-training): Pre-train NISR using surface normal loss and Eikonal regularization on ground-truth mesh data. Stage 2 (Optimization): Optimize latent vectors of the sparse feature volume using color and normal rendering losses, where normals are predicted from RGB images.
summary: Geometric Prior Guided Geometry Learning is a two-stage 3D reconstruction method that uses ground-truth mesh normals for pre-training and monocular normal predictions for volume rendering optimization.
